resale_co.name: Resale CO (made up of the Fire Marshal smoke detector certificate of compliance plus the sidewalk inspection certificate of compliance)
resale_co.issued_by: Borough of Haddonfield Construction and Zoning Office (Community Development), with the Bureau of Fire Prevention (Fire Marshals) and the Sidewalk Inspector
resale_co.lead_time: Notify the Borough at least 30 days before transfer of title (or within 5 days of signing the sales contract, whichever is later) for the sidewalk inspection. Lower fees apply if applications are submitted more than 10 business days before settlement.
requirements: All construction permits must be inspected and closed before the CO is released
Sidewalks, driveway aprons and walkways in the public right-of-way free of trip hazards (no lifts, holes or height differences of 1/2 inch or more)
Sidewalk repairs completed and the Borough notified at least 7 days before title transfer, or money placed in escrow and repairs done within 30 days after closing
Smoke alarm on every level (10-year sealed battery if battery powered)
CO alarm outside the bedroom area
ABC portable fire extinguisher no larger than 10 lb, within 10 feet of the kitchen
Street number at least 4 inches, contrasting and readable from the street
Historic District disclosure form if the home is in the Historic District

fees.label: Sidewalk inspection, settlement more than 10 business days away (includes first re-check after repairs)
fees.quote: FEES: $50, made payable to the Borough of Haddonfield, for the initial inspection , if settlement date is more than 10 business days away .

fees.label: Sidewalk inspection, settlement less than 10 business days away
fees.quote: If settlement date is in less than 10 business days the fee is $75.

fees.label: Sidewalk re-inspection, each (beyond the first re-check)
fees.quote: For a re-inspection and each subsequent re-inspection there shall be a fee of twenty-five dollars ($25.00) for each subsequent re-inspection

fees.label: Sidewalk late notice fee, each failure to give timely notice
fees.quote: then an additional late fee of twenty -five ($25.00) shall be charged for each failure to give timely notice.

fees.label: Historic District Disclosure Form
fees.quote: There is no fee for this form.

resale_co.how_to_apply: Submit the Smoke Detector form, Sidewalk Inspection form and (if in the Historic District) the Historic District Disclosure form to the Construction and Zoning Office, Room 104, Borough Hall, 242 Kings Highway East, with the fees in cash or check payable to the Borough of Haddonfield. Staff check permit history first. Schedule the smoke inspection directly with the Fire Marshal. Sidewalk inspections happen Tuesdays and Thursdays without an appointment; results are emailed.

evidence.quote: Selling a Home in the Borough of Haddonfield Resale CO 1. Smoke Detector Form / Fire Marshall CO Inspection

Staff will check construction permit history for property to ensure all permits have been inspected and closed. If a property has open construction permits, all inspections must pass and the permit closed before CO can be released.
Once issued, this Resale C/O certificate is valid for 90 days. Once expired, a new Resale C/O application and fee must be submitted and the sidewalk and driveway apron must be reinspected.

requires that upon the signing of a Contract for Sale of Real Estate in the Borough of Haddonfield an exterior property inspection shall be completed, prior to the transfer of legal title, by an inspector of the Borough of Haddonfield

resale_co.notes: Haddonfield's Resale CO is not a full interior housing inspection. It combines the Fire Marshal smoke/CO/extinguisher/house number inspection (fees under fire_cert) and a sidewalk/driveway apron inspection, plus a no-fee Historic District disclosure where applicable. Sidewalk fee conflict: the January 2025 sidewalk form says $50 if settlement is more than 10 business days away and $75 if less; the ordinance text quoted on the form and web page only states a $50 initial fee. Sidewalk inspection is not required for certain condos (Haddonfield Commons, The Mews, Kings Court, Townhomes on Washington). Do not place For Sale signs in the park strip. Rental CO is a separate program (adds lead-based paint rules for pre-1978 rentals). Sidewalk Inspector email SKrohn@haddonfield-nj.gov.

requirements: All single-station battery smoke alarms must be the 10-year sealed battery type
Hardwired (110-volt) smoke detectors maintained per manufacturer and the code in effect at installation
ABC-type extinguisher, no larger than 10 lb, within 10 feet of the kitchen area
Street number at least 4 inches, contrasting, readable from the street
Form includes a check for a secondary power source
No inspection is scheduled until all open permits are closed

authorities.name: Borough of Haddonfield Bureau of Fire Prevention (Office of the Fire Marshal)
authorities.lead_time: Lowest fee if submitted more than 10 business days before settlement

fees.label: Submitted more than 10 business days before settlement
fees.quote: If the application is submitted more than 10 business days prior to settlement or change of occupancy for rental property the fee is $56

fees.label: Submitted 4 to 10 business days before settlement
fees.quote: If the application is submitted four to 10 business days prior to settlement or change of occupancy for rental property the fee is $125

fees.label: Submitted fewer than 4 business days before settlement
fees.quote: If the application is submitted fewer than four business days prior to settlement or change of occupancy for rental property the fee is $201

fees.label: First re-inspection
fees.quote: If the property does not comply with the requirements, one re- inspection will be made at no additional charge.

fees.label: Each additional re-inspection (prepaid)
fees.quote: However, additional re -inspection will require a prepaid fee of $25 for reach re-inspection.

authorities.how_to_apply: Submit the Sale and Rental of Residential Property Ordinance Compliance Application with payment (cash or check to the Borough of Haddonfield) at the Construction and Zoning Office, Room 104, Borough Hall. Then schedule directly with the Fire Marshal's Office; inspections are Tuesdays or Wednesdays, 9 a.m. to 1 p.m. If it passes, a copy of the approval is left on site.

evidence.quote: The Borough of Haddonfield, Bureau of Fire Prevention is responsible for inspection of all one- and two-family dwelling units.

The fee for this inspection shall be $56 made payable to the Borough of Haddonfield, if the application is submitted and paid 10 days prior to settlement or signing of lease. The fee shall be $125 if application is made within 4-10 business days in advance, and the fee shall be $201 if the application is made fewer than 4 business days in advance.
SCHEDULING: You are responsible for scheduling the appointment with the Fire Marshal's Office (856-429-4308, ext. 504/505) or email EBusch@haddonfield-nj.gov / JWalls@haddonfield-nj.gov

fire_cert.notes: DCA LEA Registry (July 2026) lists Haddonfield's fire code enforcing agency as 'M' (Municipality), consistent with the Borough Bureau of Fire Prevention. Web page and current form agree on $56 / $125 / $201 and $25 extra re-inspections. Fee waived only for a new home sold within 60 days of its Certificate of Occupancy. Fire Official Ernest Busch (ebusch@haddonfield-nj.gov, 856-429-4700 ext. 504); Fire Inspector Joseph S. Walls (jwalls@haddonfield-nj.gov, ext. 505). The Fire Department page lists 856-429-4700 for these staff, while the form lists 856-429-4308 for scheduling. The older Watchdog lead URL (with a doubled path) is a 404; correct page is the one in department_url.

other_items.label: Open construction permits must be closed
other_items.detail: Staff check permit history; all permits must be inspected and closed before the Resale CO is released, and no smoke inspection is scheduled while permits are open.

other_items.label: Sidewalk and driveway apron inspection
other_items.detail: Required on every sale; repairs or escrow before closing.

other_items.label: Historic District disclosure
other_items.detail: Buyers must be notified if the property is in the Historic District (Ch. 135-60). No fee.

other_items.label: Move-out/move-in trash pickup
other_items.detail: Schedule with Public Works at 856-429-0183 before putting out excess trash.

open_questions: Sidewalk fee: form says $75 if settlement is under 10 business days away, but the ordinance text only lists $50; confirm which is current.
Fire certificate validity period not stated separately from the 90-day Resale C/O.
